reference.note: Mager DE, Jusko WJ 2001, J Pharmacokinet Pharmacodyn 28:507. TMDD; mass-action binding occupancy O = D/(Kd+D).

mass_action_occupancy_at_100nM.note: Mass-action occupancy O = D/(Kd+D) = 100/(10+100) = 0.909 at Kd=10nM.

competitive_antagonist_reduces_effect.note: Schild-type competitive antagonism: antagonist reduces agonist effect at same agonist concentration.
